collate_fn: collate a batch of object detection data by stacking pixel values and collecting labels into a single dictionary
process_data: process training and validation data for object detection with albumentations transforms including flips, blur, and perspective
convert_bbox_yolo_to_pascal: convert bounding boxes from YOLO center format to Pascal VOC absolute coordinates for a given image size
object_detection_metrics: compute mean average precision and recall metrics for object detection predictions using torchmetrics
create_model_card: generate a formatted model card string with validation metrics, dataset tags, and base model details for object detection
